b7d522acdad578db2e351cd84aad9110b81459bc.summary: South Korea's National Police Agency warned that the North Korean groups Lazarus, Andariel and Kimsuky breached South Korean defense companies and their subcontractors to steal defense technology data. A special inspection between January 15 and February 16 found multiple firms compromised since late 2022 without knowing it. Reported access methods included exploiting poorly managed test network connection systems, using a stolen account from a maintenance company employee, and exploiting an email server flaw that allowed unauthenticated large file downloads.
